name: Sidersaura
sum: Sidersaura is one of the largest known rebbachisaurids, from the Early Cretaceous Huincul Formation of Argentina, known from four individuals.
wsnote: Described as one of the largest known rebbachisaurids; no figure was read.
holotype: MMCh-PV 70, a mature individual with a braincase fused to the skull roof, partial dorsal vertebrae, fourteen caudal vertebrae, a partial left scapula and parts of both tibiae and fibulae.
material: Remains of four individuals found in 2012.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Lerzo et al. 2025
